What is the equation of the circle given above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The general equation of a circle with radius $r$ centered at the point $(a,b)$ is 

$$
(x-a)^{2}+(y-b)^{2}={r}^{2}.
$$

From the picture, we see that our circle is centered at $C(-2,-3)$ and the radius of the circle is $r=8.$ Therefore, the equation of the circle is

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-a)^{2}+(y-b)^{2} & ={r}^{2} \\ (x-(-2))^{2}+(y-(-3))^{2} & ={8}^{2} \\ (x+2)^{2}+(y+3)^{2} & =64.\end{aligned}
$$
